tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Perrigold Foods** manufactures packaged foods in four production plants. Every production batch generates quality-assurance records — laboratory test results, inspection photographs, and signed release certificates — that are subject to food-safety regulation.

**Current Environment:**
- Storage account **stperrigoldqa** (StorageV2, West Europe) stores all quality-assurance records in Blob Storage
- The container **release-certificates** holds signed batch release documents
- Older laboratory imagery is moved to the **archive** access tier by a lifecycle management policy after 18 months
- The corporate security standard requires encryption of the storage account with keys the company controls in Azure Key Vault

**Business Requirements:**
- Regulatory retention: release certificates must be preserved unchanged for a fixed period of five years
- Food-safety inspectors occasionally demand archived records at short notice
- Encryption keys must be protected against accidental or malicious destruction

tabs.title: Compliance and Encryption Detail
tabs.content:
**Release Certificate Retention:**
- The food-safety regulator requires that release certificates, once written, can be **read but never modified or deleted** for exactly **five years** from creation — this must hold even for storage account administrators and Owners
- After the five-year period ends, the documents must become deletable again so that data-minimization rules can be applied
- The protection must be enforced by the storage platform itself, not by procedures or permissions

**Inspector Retrievals:**
- An inspector can demand a specific archived laboratory file (typically 2–6 GB) and expects to view it in **under one hour**
- Cost is a secondary concern during an inspection

**Customer-Managed Keys:**
- Encryption of stperrigoldqa must use a customer-managed key stored in the Azure Key Vault **kv-perrigold-weu**
- The platform must be able to rotate to new key versions automatically
- The security team is drafting the list of prerequisites that must be in place on the vault and on the storage account before customer-managed keys can be configured
